resources.string: Pause desktop remote access before starting a Live call. This Codex version cannot safely distinguish simultaneous desktop and voice tasks. Your pairing stays saved.
Live calls, dictation and read-aloud use your ChatGPT sign-in. Availability and limits depend on your account. No API key needed.
Voice features need your ChatGPT sign-in. Reconnect Codex in Hans. No API key needed.
The ChatGPT Live voice limit has been reached. Check your account limits and try again later. Adding API credit does not reset this limit.
Codex Live voice is not currently available for this account or runtime. No API fallback was started.
The Hans task is not ready for Live. Wait for Codex to reconnect, then start the call again.
The Codex Live call could not connect or was interrupted. Check the connection and try again. Existing tasks were not sent again.

Records locally and transcribes after you stop, using your ChatGPT sign-in. The finished text is sent once to your current Hans task. This compatibility endpoint may not be available for every account. No API key or Live call is used.
ChatGPT dictation is currently unavailable. The compatibility endpoint may not be supported by your account.
Dictation could not be transcribed. No API key was used and nothing was sent to Hans.
The dictated request could not be fully confirmed. Hans may already be working; check the chat before repeating it. The request will not be retried automatically.
The previous voice session has not finished closing. Wait briefly and try again. If this persists, report this error for diagnosis. Running Codex tasks have not been interrupted.
